a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the build-to-8 plan almost certainly ends with both of us at 0. I plan to take 4 from the reserve in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you, so you can decide your own move with full information.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4. I won't take any more cells.
